name: implementation-planning
description: Use when translating an approved Plan milestone into a phase-specific, executable Implementation Plan.
---

# Implementation Planning

Create a plan for one milestone and one phase only.

Include:
- predecessor evidence
- exact files/components in scope
- ordered changes
- tests/verification
- rollback or recovery where relevant
- explicit exclusions

For database work, include data migration, compatibility, deployment ordering, and rollback/recovery. For distributed changes, include idempotency, concurrency, retries, and partial failure where relevant.
